published_ranges._notes: Values from the sovol3d.com 'Sovol Glow in dark PLA Filament 1 KG' listing (Nozzle Temperature 200-240C, Bed Temperature 50-60C), confirmed only via search-engine extraction because sovol3d.com returned HTTP 429 to direct fetches. No density, tolerance, drying or speed published. Glow powder is abrasive in general, but the Sovol hardened-nozzle advice could not be read on the blog.
